regions.name: São Francisco
regions.quote: IUCN Red List: Parotocinclus jumbo is distributed in coastal rivers of the Northeast and the lower São Francisco River, being frequent and abundant.

regions.name: Paraiba do Norte
regions.quote: South America: Paraiba do Norte and Piranhas rivers in Paraiba State, Canhotinho River in Pernambuco State, a tributary of the Mundau River, flowing near the city of Maceio in Alagoas State, and Salgado River in Ceara State.
